description: This receipt is issued by Neosurf and documents the activation of a Neosurf OnDemand prepaid voucher with a face value of 100.00 EUR. The receipt includes the transaction date and time, terminal number, trace number, transaction authentication number (TAN), voucher value, serial number, and the voucher Code/PIN required for online redemption. The instructions explain that the voucher expires six months after its first use, provide the final validity date, and direct customers to the Neosurf website for the terms and conditions and customer support. The receipt concludes with a reminder to treat the voucher as cash, reflecting the stored-value nature of the product. The overall layout is representative of a European prepaid digital payment voucher activation receipt, combining voucher activation details, redemption credentials, and customer usage instructions within a compact receipt format.
